name: nuxt-app
_comment0: Some error when adding i18n told me to add type: module. But that didn't remove the error
_comment_on_tailwindcss_dependency: is necessary to avoid cryptic hydration bugs when loading tailwind.config.js from client js via resolveConfig()
(The bug: Nuxt 500 screen with `does not provide an export named 'default'` error (appearing during hydration, I think) triggering page-reload in an endless loop)
Before, shamefully-hoist=true in .npmrc apparently pulled in the dep properly from @nuxtjs/tailwindcss
but pnpm 11 ignores shamefully-hoist silently (according to Opus 5).
Claude Opus 5 [Sep 2026]: tailwindcss version pinned to 3.4.12 to satisfy @nuxtjs/tailwindcss@6.12.1's `~3.4.4`
_comments_on_scripts: 1. Calling it 'upload', bc 'deploy' seems to be reserved in pnpm
2. To test deployment version, run `generate`, then follow instructions in terminal to serve locally.
